info.name: Senior Connect API
info.description:
Backend API for the Senior Connect Platform ("Activity Together") — Mobile App + Admin Dashboard.

NestJS + TypeScript + PostgreSQL/TypeORM. Field names follow the Figma designs exactly.

**Setup**
1. Run the API: `cd senior-connect-api && npm run start:dev` (default `http://localhost:5000/api/v1`).
2. Seed data: `npm run seed` → admin `admin@contenthub.io` / `admin123` + 13 Figma categories.
3. Run **Auth (Admin) → Admin Login** and **Auth (Mobile) → Login** first — tokens are captured automatically into `{{adminAccessToken}}` / `{{accessToken}}`.

All responses use the envelope `{ success, message, data, meta? }`.
